out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. EHS OBSERVED A CARDBOARD INSECT TRAP TAPED TO SOAP DISPENSER AT HAND SINK LOCATED NEXT TO DONUT RACK.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL PEST CONTROL MEASURES MUST BE USED AND STORED PROPERLY. PIC REMOVED THE INSECT TRAP FROM THE SOAP DISPENSER AND PLACED IT ON THE FLOOR UNDERNEATH THE HAND SINK.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no valid Certified Food Manager present in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. PIC TOLD EHS THAT THEY HAVE AN UPDATED CERTIFICATE THAT HAS NOT BEEN EMAILED TO THEM YET. ONCE THE CERTIFICATE IS EMAILED TO THE PIC THEY WILL EMAIL EHS A COPY. EHS WILL REACH OUT IN 10 DAYS TO SEE IF THEY HAVE RECEIVED THEIR CERTIFICATE. .

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 1DR UCR (1) & 1DR UCR (2) did not have thermometers in either of the units.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT ALL UNITS MUST HAVE THERMOMETERS INSIDE OF THE UNITS. PIC HAD EXTRA THERMOMETERS IN THE OFFICE TO PUT ONE IN EACH UNIT WITHOUT ONE.
